recognize_zh: 四格高倍影像中都可見大型組織球，胞質淡藍、充滿空泡，內含被吞噬的紅血球、有核細胞（淋巴球、顆粒球或有核紅血球）及碎片，這種大量噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）配合臨床指標提示噬血性淋巴組織球增生症（HLH）。
features: Large activated histiocytes with abundant pale blue, foamy to vacuolated cytoplasm in all four panels
Engulfed erythrocytes seen as pale pink-grey round profiles within phagocytic vacuoles
Phagocytosed nucleated cells (lymphocytes, granulocytes and/or nucleated red cells) and nuclear debris
Histiocyte nuclei eccentric, oval to elongated, with fine chromatin, often compressed by ingested material
Background of red cells, small lymphocytes and neutrophils without overt blasts or lymphoma cells in these fields
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa), shown as a four-panel composite, demonstrates multiple enlarged histiocytes with abundant pale blue, vacuolated cytoplasm. The histiocytes contain phagocytosed erythrocytes as well as engulfed nucleated hematopoietic cells, including lymphocytes, granulocytes and nucleated red cells, and nuclear debris. No blasts or overtly malignant lymphoid cells are identified in these fields. Findings are consistent with prominent hemophagocytosis, supportive of hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis when correlated with HLH-2004 criteria (ferritin, triglycerides, fibrinogen, sCD25, cytopenias) and evaluation for triggers such as EBV and T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Occasional hemophagocytosis is nonspecific, so the diagnosis of HLH rests on meeting clinical/laboratory criteria rather than morphology alone.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma-associated HLH (e.g. T/NK-cell lymphoma, intravascular lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Morphologically identical hemophagocytosis requires a search for atypical lymphoid cells, flow cytometry, EBER-ISH and clonality studies.
MAS is a rheumatologic-associated form of secondary HLH distinguished by the underlying autoimmune disease rather than morphology.
Emperipolesis shows intact viable lymphocytes within S100+ histiocytes with pale nuclei, rather than degraded ingested red cells in CD68+/S100- macrophages.
